preconditions.description: The height of the playing field is between 1 and 1000.
The width of the playing field is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: Each line in the input contains exactly m characters.
preconditions.description: The field is represented by n lines, each with m characters.
The field is filled with '#' for initially filled cells and '.' for empty cells.

postconditions.expression: Output is either '-1' or a valid filling of the field.
postconditions.description: If there is no way to fill the field, output '-1'. Otherwise, output a valid filling.

postconditions.expression: All initially filled cells are represented by '#'.
postconditions.description: The output must maintain the initially filled cells as '#'.

postconditions.expression: All figures are connected and entirely inside the board.
postconditions.description: Each figure must be connected by side and must not extend beyond the board boundaries.

postconditions.expression: Each empty cell is filled with exactly one cell of some figure.
postconditions.description: Every empty cell must be filled with a part of a figure.

postconditions.expression: Figures that touch each other by side are represented by distinct digits.
postconditions.description: Adjacent figures must be represented by different digits.

invariants.expression: The output must be a valid representation of the field.
invariants.description: The output must be a valid way to represent the field with figures and empty cells filled.
